title: TensorSSM: Memorizing Spatial Position in Dynamic State Space for Tensor Core Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.40871v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: High-dimensional tensors are ubiquitous in real-world applications but lead to massive storage overhead. Functional tensor decomposition addresses this by employing neural networks to map element coordinates to tensor cores, significantly reducing the parameters for data compression. However, existing functional methods typically flatten high-order tensors into 1D sequences. This folding operation causes highly overlapping local coordinate sequences and struggles to capture complex cross-mode spatial dependencies, severely limiting their expressiveness on diverse datasets. To tackle these challenges, we propose TensorSSM, a novel Implicit Neural Representation (INR) for functional decomposition method that memorizes spatial positions within a dynamic State Space Model (SSM). translated_title: TensorSSM：在动态状态空间中记忆空间位置以生成张量核
translated_abstract: 高维张量在现实世界的应用中无处不在，但会带来巨大的存储开销。函数式张量分解通过利用神经网络将元素坐标映射到张量核来应对这一问题，显著减少了数据压缩所需的参数量。然而，现有的函数式方法通常将高阶张量展平为一维序列。这种折叠操作会导致高度重叠的局部坐标序列，且难以捕捉复杂的跨模态空间依赖关系，严重限制了此类方法在多样化数据集上的表达能力。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了TensorSSM，这是一种用于函数式分解的新型隐式神经表示（INR）方法，它在动态状态空间模型（SSM）中记忆空间位置。具体而言，TensorSSM首先将各模态的坐标分解为按K叉规则切分的序列，从粗到细地编码空间标记，有效捕捉……
tldr: 提出TensorSSM，一种在动态状态空间模型（SSM）中记忆空间位置的新型隐式神经表示函数式张量分解方法，通过K叉规则从粗到细编码空间标记，克服了现有方法因展平高阶张量为一维序列而导致的表达能力受限问题。
en_tdlr: TensorSSM is a novel implicit neural representation for functional tensor decomposition that memorizes spatial positions within a dynamic State Space Model and encodes spatial tokens from coarse to fine via K-ary splitting, overcoming the limited expressiveness of existing methods that flatten high-order tensors into 1D sequences.
